about.title: FitForge AI ke Baare Mein
about.heroDesc: FitForge AI ek personalized fitness platform hai jo users ko single platform se workout plan karne, nutrition manage karne, progress track karne, sahi supplements discover karne aur nearby gyms find karne mein help karta hai.
about.whyDesc: Fitness information aksar alag-alag apps aur websites par scattered hoti hai. FitForge AI ko sabhi essential fitness tools ek jagah laane aur fitness planning sabhi ke liye simple banane ke liye create kiya gaya tha.
about.purposeHeadline: Aapke fitness goals easily achieve karne ke liye built:
purposes: Calories, protein aur water monitor karein
Apne goal aur budget ke hisaab se supplements find karein
AI fitness assistant ka use karein
about.whatYouCanDo: FitForge AI Se Aap Kya Kar Sakte Hain

features.fitnessPlanDesc: Apni height, weight aur fitness goal enter karein aur instantly customized workout & diet strategy paayein.
features.workoutDesc: Structured daily routines, targeted exercises, sets, reps aur rest timers dekhein.
features.dietDesc: Daily meals ko automatic macro breakdown (calories, protein, carbs & fats) ke saath track karein.
features.progressDesc: Weight, completed workouts, hydration, calories, protein aur steps ko clean charts par track karein.
features.aiCoachDesc: Workout, diet, exercise form aur recovery questions ke instant answers paayein AI assistant se.
features.supplementDesc: Goal, budget aur diet preference (Veg/Non-Veg/Vegan) ke according best supplements find karein.
features.gymFinderDesc: Location access se apne aas-pass ke top gyms map, distance filters aur directions ke saath find karein.
features.dashboardDesc: Active streak, workout status, nutrition stats aur water progress ek hi place par dekhein.

about.founderDesc: FitForge AI ko ek modern fitness technology project ke roop mein create kiya gaya tha jisse workout planning, nutrition guidance, supplement discovery, progress tracking aur gym discovery ek hi platform se easy ho sakein.
about.founderSubDesc: Simple user experience, modern tech aur practical fitness tools par focus karke banaya gaya hai.
about.techSubtitle: Modern tech stack driving FitForge AI
about.missionText: Useful fitness tools ko ek modern platform mein laakar fitness planning ko simpler, more accessible aur easy to understand banana.
